stem: A final-batch EC is unexpectedly high. What is the strongest first response?
choices: Verify sample identity and meter performance with the controlled reference/check before changing the batch.
Dilute immediately until the display matches target.
Delete the first reading and retest until a normal value appears.
Increase nutrient concentration because high EC indicates deficiency.
rationale: Verify sample identity and meter performance with the controlled reference/check before changing the batch.
